name: holiday-feast
description: Skills and a knowledge base for cooking a Thanksgiving or holiday turkey or ham, planning and timing the meal, food safety and leftovers, and using Madison Park Foods seasonings.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, cook and time a holiday turkey or ham
interface.longDescription: Eight skills and a 19-file knowledge base for first-time and experienced holiday hosts: meal planning and quantities, thawing and brining, roasting turkey (classic, spatchcock, breast, smoked, fried), reheating and glazing ham, day-of timelines for one oven, gravy and sides, fixes for problems mid-cook, USDA food-safety temperatures and leftover storage, and guidance on Madison Park Foods seasonings such as Chairman of the Bird.
defaultPrompt: Walk me through roasting a 14 lb turkey.
Build a timeline for dinner at 4 PM.
